data.name: 横断異道-The Crosswalk Anomaly
data.detailed_description:
Crosswalks you must not cross—unless something is wrong.

Look carefully to the right, to the left, and all around before you step forward.

Some crosswalks may show no anomalies at all.

---

◎Rules

  • There are two types of crossings: pedestrian crossings (when no anomaly occurs) and anomalous crossings (when an anomaly occurs).

  • For pedestrian crossings, no anomalies occur, so it is always safe to cross whenever the signal sounds.

  • For anomalous crossings, an anomaly may occur while the signal is sounding. An anomaly does not happen every time the signal sounds.

    Therefore, you need to observe the stage several times while the signal is active. Patience, observation, and decision-making skills are required.

  • When you spot an anomaly, cross the road while the anomaly is occurring. Even in stages with anomalies, crossing when none are active is very dangerous.

  • As a general guideline: if you check and see that no anomalies occur after several observations, it can be treated as a normal pedestrian crossing and you may cross.

    However, if you simply haven't noticed an anomaly yet, it will come down to luck.

  • In some cases, you may not be able to cross the entire road at once, but if you manage to cross at least half of it, you’ll be fine.

    You can then wait for the next signal to complete the crossing.

In short, once you successfully cross even half of the road, you can consider the stage cleared.

※※

The final stage has no anomalies.

There’s a 50% chance of getting hit by a car.

There’s a 50% chance of crossing safely.
Let's test your luck.

※※

---

Features

“Exit 8”-like horror experience

First-person, loop-style horror game

Observation-based gameplay that tests your ability to spot subtle “anomalies”

Cross or wait — your choice determines life or death

Immersive, tension-filled atmosphere

---

【Controls】

・Movement

Arrow Keys or WASD

・Camera Control

Mouse Drag (Up/Down/Left/Right)

・Pause

P Key

・Cursor Control During Pause

Mouse Drag (Up/Down/Left/Right)

・Confirm

Left Click

---

Regarding video content

Streaming and video uploads are allowed.

Please include the game title and URL in your post or description.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10/11(64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400/AMD Ryzen5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDA GTX1060/AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card:DirectX compatible
